purpose: Function/wait/allocation profiling of unchanged optimized production detector functions. No model fitting or accuracy experiment.

hardware.note: DirectML adapter number recorded as reported; GPU selection policy and models unchanged. Other owner apps/scans stayed running; timings are local and workload dependent.

method.system_profiler_attempt: WPR CPU failed OS privilege with0xc5585011; no system policy changed
method.fallback: External process-local StackWalk64 sample, per-thread suspend/resume, matching optimized PDB and LLVM source/inline resolution
method.busy_share_definition: Non-wait stack snapshots; not exact CPU cycles. Runnable descheduled stacks may be sampled.
method.target: Real parallel_frames_indexed queue and production PovMatcher/candidate_prepared/Engine; cached RGB producer excludes video decoding
method.native_build_contention: Another agent built the native application during some collection/control runs; owner apps/scans remained active. Throughput/overhead not controlled.
method.wait_sums: Aggregate across multiple scanner workers; can exceed wall time
method.allocation_counter: Separate global Rust allocator wrapper, alloc/alloc_zeroed/realloc requests plus requested size; excludes native ONNX/DirectML/FFmpeg allocation

limits: 32 unique frames repeated, not new accuracy evaluation
Profiling-only adapters are local ignored scratch; no production detector changes in this pass
Native driver symbols may resolve only to exports; use them only to classify waits, not exact internal functions
No FFmpeg function trace, frontend trace, GPU kernel timeline or hardware saturation claim
Allocation/reallocation requested byte totals are not retained RAM
No numerical profiler overhead claim: background load varied and POV control slower than sampled run
